parts.text: Ultra-realistic editorial photograph, 16:9. Front-facing eye-level medium shot across a desk: a young Indian software engineer in his mid-20s sits behind an open silver Apple MacBook Pro (we see the back of the laptop lid facing the camera, plain aluminium with no visible logo), his face lit softly by the screen, focused and slightly mischievous expression, short natural black hair, light stubble, light-grey crew-neck t-shirt under an unbuttoned dark-navy linen overshirt, silver watch. Modern bright home office behind him: white walls, light oak shelving with a few books and a ceramic vase, a large window with soft overcast daylight from the side, a small green plant on the desk, a ceramic coffee mug. Shot on a full-frame cinema camera, 50mm lens at f/2, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture with pores and subtle imperfections, true-to-life colours, gentle filmic contrast, neutral whites with a faint mint-green tint in the shadows. Documentary realism, not CGI, not illustration. No text, no logos.
